name: @pipeworx/mcp-randomuser

tools.name: generate_users
tools.description: Generate random user profiles with names, addresses, emails, and photos. Filter by nationality (e.g., "US", "GB", "AU") and specify count for multiple profiles.

count.description: Number of users to generate (default 1, max 100).

nationality.description: Comma-separated nationality codes to filter by (e.g. "us,gb,au"). Supported: AU, BR, CA, CH, DE, DK, ES, FI, FR, GB, IE, IN, IR, MX, NL, NO, NZ, RS, TR, UA, US.

tools.name: generate_by_gender
tools.description: Generate random user profiles by gender ("male" or "female"). Returns names, contact info, photos, and demographics. Specify count for multiple profiles.

gender.description: Gender to filter by. One of: male, female.

count.description: Number of users to generate (default 1, max 100).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-randomuser forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the randomuser pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
